question_text: Which of the following statements regarding the X-ray production in common applications is incorrect?

options.option_text: Two circuits are used in the X-ray production system.
Low voltage is sufficient to heat the cathode.
Energy of the X-rays emitted depends on the current through the filament.
Energy of the X-rays emitted depends on the current of electrons.
X-ray tube must be evacuated to avoid the energy loss of electrons.
